text:
Type: metal and glass shelving unit
Use: displaying books, plants and decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame, clear tempered glass shelves, solid white bottom shelf
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: tall open frame of thin square tubes split into two bays, glass shelves over a solid bottom shelf, open sides and back, see-through and very light
Feel: airy, light, clean, delicate
Goes with: white walls, light wood, green plants, pale textiles; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: VITTSJ
product.description: Tempered glass and metal are durable materials that provide an open, airy feel.
